items.text:
There is a good game here, but it's buggy. I would wait till most of it is worked out. 

The bugs are weird, you will try to target a ship, then try show it on map, but instead of showing the ship you're trying to target, it will select a station. It's weird little bugs like that, the quests are bugged and not functional. 

The game it self is pretty good, the art style is great and there is a lot to do in expanding your ship, after the first handfuls of striping other ships money doesn't become an issue and you can spend your time doing what ever you want. 

A lot is not explained, you will need to go through the first 10 or so hours confused about everything and how it works. After that you kinda get what is going on, the start can be rough when you have no money.

It's a thumbs up because the game has real good potential, but it's far from finished.
items.text_zh:
这里有一款好游戏，但它有bug。我会等到大部分问题被解决再说。

这些bug很奇怪，你会尝试锁定一艘飞船，然后尝试在地图上显示它，但它不会显示你试图锁定的那艘飞船，而是会选中一个空间站。就是这种奇怪的小bug，任务也有bug而且无法正常运作。

游戏本身相当不错，美术风格很棒，而且在扩展你的飞船方面有很多事可做，在最初剥了几艘其他飞船之后，钱就不再是问题，你可以把时间花在任何你想做的事情上。

很多东西都没有解释，你会在最初10个小时左右对一切以及它如何运作感到困惑。在那之后，你大概就明白是怎么回事了，当你没钱的时候开局可能会很艰难。

给好评是因为这款游戏有非常好的潜力，但它远未完成。
